HDT AND VICAT TESTING SYSTEMS
Product catalog summary
Overview: The document provides technical specifications for the HV3S, HV6M, and HV6X testing stations, highlighting their capabilities and features.
Specifications:
Number of Testing Stations: HV3S supports up to 3 stations, while HV6M and HV6X support up to 6 stations.
Station Movement: HV3S is manually controlled, whereas HV6M and HV6X are machine controlled.
Application of Test Weights: Manual for HV3S and HV6M, machine controlled for HV6X.
Heat Transfer Medium: All models use silicone oil.
Oil Bath Capacity: HV3S has a capacity of 9 liters (2.4 USA gal), while HV6M and HV6X have 16 liters (4.2 USA gal).
Temperature Range: 20 – 300°C (68 – 572°F) for all models.
Temperature Resolution: 0.1°C (0.18°F) for all models.
LVDT Resolution: 0.001 mm (0.00004 in) for all models.
Dimensions: HV3S: 938 x 480 x 713 mm; HV6M: 1291 x 480 x 780 mm; HV6X: 1291 x 550 x 900 mm.
Mass (without oil): HV3S: 80 kg (176 lb); HV6M: 140 kg (309 lb); HV6X: 160 kg (353 lb).
Power Supply: 230 ±5%, 50/60 Hz and 120 ±5%, 30A, 50/60 Hz for all models, with maximum power consumption of 2800 W for HV3S and 3200 W for HV6M and HV6X.
Data Connections: Ethernet for PC and USB for printer for all models.
Innovation Statement: The document includes a statement from Yahya Gharagozlou, Group President of ITW Test & Measurement, emphasizing the importance of understanding customer needs to create innovative solutions that are simpler, smarter, and safer.
Trademark Information: Instron is a registered trademark of Illinois Tool Works Inc. (ITW), and other names and logos are trademarks of their respective companies.
